videos.overview: Isa confronts Jacky once again while Fernanda and Robbie reconcile. Abel desperately seeks Eli's forgiveness and Jawy resorts to witchcraft to get it.

videos.title: Girls party
videos.overview: The men receive a visit that will completely transform them, while at the party Jacky brings chaos to the celebration. Andrés confronts Abel but his bodyguard arrives to protect him.

videos.title: The early farewell
videos.overview: Andrés makes a radical decision while Karime celebrates her bachelorette party. Fernanda sees an uncertain future with Robbie and the originals remember their time on the Shore vacation.

videos.title: The last party
videos.overview: The time has come to say goodbye, but before leaving, the Shores celebrate at the Bar Morelos. A shaman will guide them on the path to inner peace and little by little each one will say goodbye to the holidays.

videos.title: Party in Acapulco
videos.overview: The Shore family returns to Acapulco to enjoy a nice vacation. New characters make their appearance and while everyone gets to know each other, one person becomes the apple of discord on the first night of an intense vacation.

videos.title: The apple of discord
videos.overview: The party gets tense and Andrea ends up confronting all the women in the house. The boss makes his appearance while the jealousy continues and could ruin the good time they are having.

videos.title: Don't take it personally
videos.overview: The holidays continue but the situation is increasingly tense for Abigail. The boss gives them their uniforms and while some of them work out at the gym, others work but take advantage of the break to do their thing.

videos.title: A surprise gift
videos.overview: Tensions between Eli and Andrea mount, but this is no excuse for them to pay off their outstanding debts. Work arrives and Abigail finds out about the damage to her clothes, which causes her to explode.

videos.title: I don't notice
videos.overview: Tensions between Eli and Andrea mount, but this is no excuse for them to pay off their outstanding debts. Work arrives and Abigail finds out about the damage to her clothes, which causes her to explode.

videos.title: Let the party not stop
videos.overview: Abigail explodes and goes against Andrea and Rexx. The relationship between Eli and Abel continues in trouble thanks to Andrea. The Shores organize a party at home but for Chuy the night turns into hell.

videos.title: The surprises never stop
videos.overview: A surprise arrives to cheer up the women of the shore house. Ricky takes the opportunity to share a secret of Andrea's and a guest will arrive at the house with the intention of stealing the hearts of men and women.

videos.title: The grasshopper
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor arrives at the house and Robbie and Alba compete for her attention. The party doesn't stop and Javo makes Leslie's night. The visitor enters into conflict with the entire house as they notice that she is playing with Alba.

videos.title: The war has just begun
videos.overview: An intervention changes the mood in the Shore house as some members no longer tolerate Abel and Eli taking over the clubhouse. A dynamic that seeks peace in the house ends in a pitched battle.

videos.title: A Difficult Decision
videos.overview: The drama doesn't stop in the shore house and the fight between Rexx and Abigail ends with a decision that nobody expected. A hypnosis session changes the mood of the vacation while a surprise guest arrives to break hearts.

videos.title: The mamucha in trouble
videos.overview: Claudia's arrival creates jealousy in Alba, while Abel fails Eli, which leads to another argument. Sebastian gets drunk and a guest arrives at the house, which makes Eli relive a relationship from the past that ended very badly.

videos.title: The drama doesn't stop
videos.overview: Tensions in the house rise and a comment from Ricky causes the relationship between Eli and Abel to falter. Visitors begin to leave the house while a chat between Eli and Jey seeks to smooth things over.

videos.title: The holidays are over
videos.overview: The holidays are coming to an end and the Shores are looking to end them in the best way possible. The farewell ritual is not long in coming and everyone begins to leave the house, leaving Chile with the responsibility of making a difficult decision.
